quests.instruction: You walk to school in the early morning when it is still dim. Which jacket is easiest for drivers to see?
quests.hint: Pick the one that stands out against the dark.
quests.explanation: Bright colors like yellow are easy to see in dim light.
quests.funFact: Safety vests are often bright yellow, orange or lime green so people can see them.

quests.instruction: A baby's bedroom is meant to feel calm and quiet. Which wall color would suit it best?
quests.hint: Remember a calm, gentle sky.
quests.explanation: Soft, light colors can make a room feel calm.
quests.funFact: Many people paint sleeping rooms in gentle colors.

quests.instruction: It is a very sunny day and you will be outside for hours. Which T-shirt will keep you cooler?
quests.hint: Dark colors soak up more heat.
quests.explanation: Light colors reflect sunlight, so a white shirt stays cooler.
quests.funFact: Dark clothes soak up more heat from the sun than light ones.

quests.instruction: Your teacher asks you to circle your mistakes in red pen so they stand out. Why red?
quests.hint: Think about what stands out on white paper.
quests.explanation: Red stands out on white paper, so it is easy to spot.
quests.funFact: Teachers often use red or green to mark homework.

quests.instruction: You highlight an important word in your notebook. Which highlighter is bright enough to see through?
quests.hint: Remember a sticky note.
quests.explanation: A bright yellow highlighter makes the word stand out without hiding it.
quests.funFact: Highlighter ink is see-through so you can still read the words.

quests.instruction: A glue stick turns clear when it dries but looks purple when you put it on. Why is it colored?
quests.correctAnswer: To see where you put it
options: To see where you put it
quests.hint: Think about why you would want to see it.
quests.explanation: The color shows where the glue is, so you do not miss any part.
quests.funFact: Some glue sticks start out one color and dry clear.

quests.instruction: Which color is the light that means "slow down and get ready to stop" at many traffic lights?
quests.hint: Picture a banana.
quests.explanation: Yellow is the middle light on many traffic signals.
quests.funFact: Traffic lights have three lights stacked on top of each other.

quests.instruction: At a pedestrian crossing the signal shows a walking person when it is safe to cross. Which color is that?
quests.hint: It is the same as the go light for cars.
quests.explanation: Green tells people it is safe to go.
quests.funFact: Some crossings use a talking signal for people who cannot see.

quests.instruction: In many places, warning signs for roadworks are shaped like a diamond. Which color is common on them?
quests.hint: Think of the cones that guide cars.
quests.explanation: Orange is used for roadwork warnings because it is easy to notice.
quests.funFact: Orange cones guide cars around work areas.

quests.instruction: In a soccer match, a referee shows a card when a player breaks a rule. Which card means a player must leave the game?
quests.hint: It is the strongest warning card.
quests.explanation: A red card means the player must leave the game.
quests.funFact: A yellow card is a warning before a red card.

quests.instruction: Many tennis balls are bright yellow-green. Why?
quests.hint: Think of how fast a ball moves.
quests.explanation: Bright colors help players follow the fast-moving ball.
quests.funFact: Tennis balls were once white.

quests.instruction: A swimmer wears a cap in a pool. Which cap color is easiest to spot in blue water?
quests.hint: It should look different from the water.
quests.explanation: Orange stands out against blue water.
quests.funFact: Lifeguards use bright colors so they are easy to see.

quests.instruction: A rainbow shows up after a rainstorm. Which two things are needed to make one?
quests.hint: Look at the sky after rain.
quests.explanation: A rainbow forms when sunlight shines through raindrops.
quests.funFact: You see a rainbow when the sun is behind you.

quests.instruction: A thunderstorm cloud looks dark gray. What does that tell you?
quests.hint: Remember the sky before it pours.
quests.explanation: Dark clouds are thick, so rain may be on the way.
quests.funFact: A thick cloud blocks the sunlight and looks dark.

quests.instruction: In autumn, you see leaves on the ground in orange, red and yellow. Which color are they before they change?
quests.hint: Remember a summer tree.
quests.explanation: Leaves are green before autumn.
quests.funFact: Cool weather makes leaves lose their green.

quests.instruction: At a party, the plates are red, the cups are blue and the napkins are yellow. Which item is yellow?
quests.hint: Match each item to its color.
quests.explanation: The napkins are yellow, the plates red and the cups blue.
quests.funFact: Party colors often follow a theme.

quests.instruction: A fruit bowl has apples, oranges and grapes. Which fruit is purple?
quests.hint: Look for the one that makes a dark juice.
quests.explanation: Grapes can be purple, while apples can be red or green.
quests.funFact: Grapes grow in bunches on vines.

quests.instruction: At a party, balloons are tied to a gate. A friend asks for the one that is the color of a lemon. Which balloon is it?
quests.hint: Picture a sour fruit.
quests.explanation: A lemon is yellow, so the yellow balloon is the match.
quests.funFact: Balloons float because they are filled with a light gas.

quests.instruction: A passenger plane flies on a clear day. Which color is the sky behind it?
quests.hint: Look at the sky on a bright day.
quests.explanation: On a clear day the sky is blue.
quests.funFact: From inside a plane, clouds look like a white floor.

quests.instruction: An airport runway has white stripes down the middle. What color is the ground under the stripes?
quests.hint: Roads are the same color.
quests.explanation: Runways are paved in dark gray, so the white stripes stand out.
quests.funFact: Runway stripes help pilots line up.

quests.instruction: A helicopter rescues someone at sea. Which color helps rescuers see a life jacket in the water?
quests.hint: Life jackets and cones share this bright color.
quests.explanation: Bright orange stands out against blue-gray water.
quests.funFact: Life jackets are bright so people can find each other.

quests.instruction: You label three boxes with colored stickers: blue, red, green. Your socks go in the box with the sticker that matches the sea. Which sticker is that?
quests.hint: Imagine a calm ocean.
quests.explanation: The sea is blue, so the blue box is for socks.
quests.funFact: Labels help us find things quickly.

quests.instruction: Mom picks a green bin for vegetables. Which vegetable would go in the bin?
quests.hint: Look for the green one.
quests.explanation: Broccoli is green, so it matches the green bin.
quests.funFact: Color labels help us keep things in order.

quests.instruction: Which of these clothes belongs in the light-colored laundry pile?
quests.hint: Light means close to white.
quests.explanation: A white shirt goes with the light colors, so dark dye cannot rub onto it.
quests.funFact: Washing dark and light clothes apart helps whites stay bright.

quests.instruction: A park sign points to the playground with a yellow arrow and to the pond with a blue arrow. Which arrow points to the pond?
quests.hint: Water is often shown in this color.
quests.explanation: The blue arrow points to the pond, since blue is often used for water.
quests.funFact: Signs use colors so people can find places quickly.

quests.instruction: A fire hydrant stands on the sidewalk. Which color is it often painted?
quests.hint: Picture fire trucks.
quests.explanation: Many fire hydrants are red so people can find them quickly.
quests.funFact: Hydrants may be painted other colors to show the water flow.

quests.instruction: A bus stop has a bench in the shade. Which color bench would look the same as a tree trunk?
quests.hint: Remember the park trees.
quests.explanation: Brown benches look like wood and blend in with trees.
quests.funFact: Wooden benches are often painted to protect them from rain.

quests.instruction: You pack a snack that matches a banana, a lemon and a sunflower. What color is it?
quests.hint: They all look like the sun.
quests.explanation: Yellow things often brighten a place.
quests.funFact: A sunflower can grow taller than a grown-up.

quests.instruction: You want a shirt that will make you easy to see in a crowd of people in dark coats. Which shirt would you pick?
quests.hint: Pick the one that stands out.
quests.explanation: Bright colors stand out, especially around dark colors.
quests.funFact: Hunters and hikers wear bright colors to be seen.

quests.instruction: It is snowing. Which color jacket would you spot easily on the white snow?
quests.hint: Pick the color that stands out.
quests.explanation: Red is easy to see on white snow.
quests.funFact: Snow can hide things that are white.
